profiles.label: Shadowbane Lab reference model v1

limitations: A simulator primitive or approximation is not evidence that the game behaved that way.

claims.subject: standard categorized effects
claims.statement: Under the standard stack rule, a newly cast effect replaces an existing equal-category/equal-rank effect only when the new spell power is greater than or equal to the existing spell power.

evidence.locator: Stack Category and Stack Rank sections
evidence.note: The page gives the standard rule but warns implicitly through per-power metadata that exceptions may exist.

test_requirements: Compile two otherwise identical effects at adjacent ranks and test both cast orders on WonderBane.
Extract the exact MagicBane effect collision path.

claims.subject: powerblock
claims.statement: A successful powerblock applies powerblock immunity for twice the block duration.

evidence.locator: Patch 2.0: immunity to powerblocks is now twice the duration of the powerblock

evidence.note: Crowd-control reconstruction should be checked for exceptions and refresh semantics.

test_requirements: Verify whether a blocked powerblock refreshes, preserves or ignores an existing immunity.
Verify self-powerblock exceptions from Patch 24.3.

claims.subject: stun
claims.statement: A successful stun applies stun immunity for three times the stun duration.

evidence.locator: effect modifier and power action subsystem; exact construction still to extract
evidence.note: Source tree exists, but this seed has not yet linked the exact data row/action path.

test_requirements: Extract stun-immunity construction from the pinned emulator source.
Measure expiry for at least three stun durations in WonderBane.

claims.subject: stun immunity
claims.statement: Attempting another stun while stun immunity is active resets the immunity duration.

evidence.note: The precise event boundary—attempt, hit, or effect application—requires confirmation.

test_requirements: Trace repeated stun attempts at multiple remaining durations.
Confirm whether rank, hit failure or target immunity changes refresh behavior.

claims.subject: stunned actor
claims.statement: Stun prevents attacks, casting, passive defense and horizontal movement, while chat, emotes, flight-tier changes, combat-mode toggle and sit toggle remain available.

evidence.note: Pinned implementation cancels on-stun actions, clears casting and stops movement; passive defense and exception surface still need full extraction.

test_requirements: Map each action family to an affordance suppression test.
Confirm the listed exceptions in the actual WonderBane client.

claims.subject: root
claims.statement: Root prevents horizontal movement, bypasses defense and breaks when the rooted target takes damage after application.
conditions: ordinary root without a power-specific exception
test_requirements: Test immediate damage in the same server frame versus later damage.
Test zero, absorbed and resisted damage.
Extract root break-condition implementation.

claims.subject: mesmerize
claims.statement: Mesmerize suppresses actions like stun, normally lasts longer, breaks on damage, grants no mesmerize immunity, and is prevented by stun immunity.
conditions: mobile target class supported by mesmerize

evidence.note: The page describes it as generally mob-oriented; exact target classes must be preserved.

test_requirements: Verify target classes and pet ownership cases.
Test absorbed or zero damage.
Test stun-immunity interaction.

claims.subject: weapon powers
claims.statement: The final official patch increased weapon-power range from 10 to 15 units.
conditions: weapon power governed by the global final-patch change

evidence.locator: General: weapon power ranges increased from 10 to 15

test_requirements: Check deployment rows for explicit per-power ranges.
Measure legality at the 15-unit boundary with movement desync.

claims.subject: Sneak
claims.statement: Sneak applies a 1.5-second self powerblock that cannot be prevented by powerblock immunity and does not grant powerblock immunity.
test_requirements: Confirm whether the lockout starts at activation, cast completion or effect application.
Verify which skills or UI actions remain legal.

claims.subject: Invisibility
claims.statement: Invisibility applies a 1.5-second self powerblock that cannot be prevented by powerblock immunity and does not grant powerblock immunity.
test_requirements: Confirm exact start time and interaction with queued Backstab or Passwall.
Verify whether this is Assassin Invisibility only or all powers sharing the name.

claims.subject: Shadow Mantle
claims.statement: Shadow Mantle blocks the initial healing tick of all heal-over-time effects.

evidence.locator: Assassin: Shadow Mantle now correctly blocks initial tick of all HoTs

test_requirements: Represent initial ticks explicitly rather than as an implicit periodic tick at time zero.
Test HoT applied before Mantle, during Mantle and after Mantle expiry.

claims.subject: invisibility
claims.statement: Invisibility ends when its bearer is damaged, attacks, uses an item or casts a power; successful AoE damage can reveal an invisible target.

evidence.note: Skills may not count as power casts for this break condition.

test_requirements: Separate attempted versus successful attack/cast/item use.
Test zero damage, absorbed damage, DoT ticks and damage shields.
Determine whether skills break invisibility.

claims.subject: skills
claims.statement: Skills do not interrupt invisibility, wereforms or Traveling Stance in the same way spellcasting does.
conditions: action is classified as a skill rather than a spell
test_requirements: Build a per-action flag table from client/deployment data.
Verify every currently modeled Assassin and Warlock action.

claims.subject: casted flight
claims.statement: A stun or snare of equal or higher rank immediately grounds a character using casted flight and dispels the enabling flight buff.
conditions: flight comes from a casted effect rather than racial/natural flight
test_requirements: Test rank boundary at one rank below, equal and one above.
Observe descent versus teleport-to-ground ordering.
Test stun or snare immunity.

claims.subject: natural flight
claims.statement: Natural flight is not interrupted by ordinary stuns or snares, although explicit grounding powers can pause it.
conditions: ordinary stun or snare without explicit grounding component
test_requirements: Enumerate every explicit Ground/Dispel Flight tag.
Test natural flyer during stun, snare, root and powerblock.

claims.subject: flight tiers
claims.statement: Flight has seven sequential tiers; a tier transition takes about two seconds and forbids horizontal movement, while a grounded attacker cannot hit a target two or more tiers above.

evidence.locator: Flight tiers and combat reach sections
evidence.note: The transition time is approximate and should not compile as exact timing yet.

test_requirements: Measure transition times and quantization in WonderBane.
Test spells, bows, crossbows and melee separately.
Add terrain and line-of-sight fixtures.

claims.subject: horizontal movement speed
claims.statement: Final horizontal speed is base speed multiplied by one plus cumulative speed modifiers, with Running increasing base speed by 0.25% per skill point, horizontal flight adding 30% to base, and a 41-unit-per-second cap.
conditions: before unknown implementation-specific rounding or state exceptions

evidence.locator: Movement speed formula, Running, flight and cap sections
movement subsystem; exact formula path still to extract
evidence.note: The implementation profile may apply different order, rounding or caps.

test_requirements: Extract MovementManager formula at the target commit.
Measure displacement over fixed intervals for racial bases, Running, buffs and snares.
Test whether the cap applies before or after snares.

claims.subject: stamina depletion
claims.statement: At very low or zero stamina, the character falls back to walk mode, returns to the ground if flying, and stops using the weapon.

evidence.note: The page language does not establish the exact numerical threshold or ordering.

test_requirements: Determine exact threshold and event ordering.
Test queued weapon powers, auto-attack, natural flight and casted flight.
Measure recovery before actions become legal again.

claims.subject: typed resistance
claims.statement: Effective resistance is soft-capped at 75%, while debuffs subtract from the uncapped raw resistance before the cap is applied; negative resistance increases damage.
conditions: excluding explicit immunity or special absorber logic

evidence.note: The exact emulator arithmetic and rounding order are not yet linked.

test_requirements: Extract damage and resistance order from CombatManager.
Test raw resistance above cap with exposes of several magnitudes.
Test negative resistance and absorber ordering.

claims.subject: weapon suffix armor piercing
claims.statement: One Morloch formula reconstruction says weapon-suffix armor piercing reduces the target's current resistance multiplicatively.
test_requirements: Extract ArmorPiercingEffectModifier and damage order at the pinned server commit.
Run fixed-damage tests at 0, 25, 75 and 100 raw resistance.

claims.subject: armor piercing
claims.statement: A separate Morloch mechanics page describes armor piercing as a flat reduction from effective resistance, including against raw resistance above the 75% cap.
conditions: interpretation from Armor Piercing mechanics page

evidence.locator: Resist cap behavior used to qualify ordering
evidence.note: The formulas page gives a multiplicative current-resistance formula instead.

evidence.locator: General power/effect metadata does not resolve armor-piercing arithmetic
evidence.note: The dedicated Armor Piercing page must be pinned as its own source in the next ingestion pass.

test_requirements: Pin the Armor Piercing page revision.
Extract implementation and run the same resistance matrix as the multiplicative hypothesis.

claims.subject: hit roll
claims.statement: The hit chance never falls below five percent.
conditions: ordinary attack or power hit roll

evidence.note: The precise formula and clamp order remain unverified.

test_requirements: Extract exact hit-roll function and clamp order.
Run enough deterministic seeds to distinguish a 5% floor from neighboring hypotheses.

claims.subject: Backstab
claims.statement: Backstab is a next-swing weapon modifier that ignores passive defense.
conditions: Backstab modifier remains active until the qualifying weapon swing
final retail includes the passive-defense fix

evidence.note: Final patch contains additional Backstab fixes that require separate claims.

test_requirements: Represent activation separately from the later weapon swing.
Test miss, active defense, target death, weapon swap and timeout between activation and swing.

claims.subject: weapon-dependent powers
claims.statement: Weapon powers dispel when the required weapon is unequipped.
conditions: effect requires the equipped weapon category

evidence.locator: Patch 1.5: weapon powers dispel if weapon unequipped

test_requirements: Test next-swing modifiers, ongoing weapon buffs and deferred effects separately.
Test weapon swap after launch but before resolution.

claims.subject: damage absorbers
claims.statement: Specified damage absorbers deplete from damage actually inflicted after resistances, rather than from pre-resistance raw damage.
conditions: absorber governed by the documented corrected behavior

evidence.locator: Patch note correction: absorbers count 750 damage actually inflicted after resistance
evidence.note: The affected absorber list and universal versus power-specific scope require extraction.

test_requirements: Extract common absorber path to determine whether the rule is universal or power-specific.
Test partial absorption, overkill, negative resistance and multiple damage types.

claims.subject: pulsing powers
claims.statement: Pulsing powers check powerblock state rather than continuing unconditionally.
test_requirements: Determine whether powerblock suppresses future ticks, cancels the pulse, or pauses and resumes.
Test source powerblock versus target powerblock.

claims.subject: deferred power components
claims.statement: Some deferred components perform their own hit roll independently of the initiating weapon hit.
conditions: power/action explicitly uses the corrected deferred-hit behavior

evidence.locator: Patch 3.0: specified deferred components require their own hit roll
evidence.note: The specific component list must be extracted into per-power claims.

test_requirements: Model delivery/resolution stages with distinct rolls.
Catalog which powers use inherited hit success versus independent deferred rolls.

claims.subject: Shadow Mantle
claims.statement: The 2015 emulator Patch 1.5 made Shadow Mantle block percent heals, use a one-second cast, last 30 seconds and recycle in 30 seconds.
conditions: not retail Patch 1.5 and not automatically WonderBane

evidence.note: The mutable page still needs a permanent revision snapshot.

test_requirements: Do not inherit these values into retail-final or WonderBane without a profile match.
Fingerprint WonderBane patch lineage before comparison.
